stories.title: Vinícius, Blanca Suárez o Helen Svedin: los famosos que no se pierden el Madring

en.title: Vinícius, Blanca Suárez or Helen Svedin: the celebrities who don't want to miss Madring
en.summary: Multiple Spanish and international celebrities attended the Madring, Spain's Formula 1 Championship race, after several days of practice. Prominent brands invited international stars and Real Madrid players, who were included on the official guest list.

stories.title: Rusia ataca la zona fronteriza entre Polonia y Ucrania, a pocos kilómetros de territorio OTAN

en.title: Russia attacks the border area between Poland and Ukraine, just kilometers from NATO territory
en.summary: A drone struck a train traveling between Kyiv and Warsaw near the Polish border. Lithuania suspended airport operations in Vilnius due to a possible drone threat.

stories.title: OpenAI anuncia que no saldrá a bolsa este año por los riesgos de seguridad de la inteligencia artificial

en.title: OpenAI announces it will not go public this year due to artificial intelligence safety risks
en.summary: OpenAI will not conduct an initial public offering in 2025, with CEO Sam Altman citing current safety concerns in artificial intelligence as the reason. The company indicated it is unlikely to pursue a public listing before 2027.

stories.title: Dos detenidos por matar a un joven de 24 años y apuñalar a otro en Parla

en.title: Two arrested for killing a 24-year-old youth and stabbing another in Parla
en.summary: Police arrested two men as suspected perpetrators of a knife attack that killed a 24-year-old and wounded another person in Parla.

stories.title: Un Madrid de más a menos golea al Rayo, pero no silencia los pitos

en.title: A declining Madrid thrashes Rayo, but doesn't silence the whistles
en.summary: Real Madrid defeated Rayo Vallecano 3-0 but performed poorly, continuing a pattern of wins accompanied by fan disapproval at the Bernabéu. The team has won all four home matches this season, though two were accompanied by whistles from the crowd.

stories.title: Las 'fan zone', tres maneras de vivir la gran carrera: «Es caro, pero teníamos que venir a verlo»

en.title: Fan zones, three ways to experience the big race: 'It's expensive, but we had to come see it'
en.summary: Formula 1 organizers for Madrid's 2026 Grand Prix created multiple fan zones to provide spectators with an enhanced experience justifying ticket costs, as the sport can be fully watched on television.

stories.title: Fallece un joven de 24 años tras una puñalada en el cuello por una agresión en Parla

en.title: 24-year-old dies after neck stabbing in assault in Parla
en.summary: A young man aged 24 was fatally stabbed in the neck during an assault in Parla, with national police investigating the incident.

stories.title: Las noventa tumbas sin nombre de Ceuta

en.title: The ninety nameless graves of Ceuta
en.summary: Ninety unidentified individuals have been buried in unmarked common graves at a Muslim cemetery in Ceuta following the deaths from a migration incident at Tarajal beach.

stories.title: Jornada histórica en Madrid: la Fórmula 1 llega a la capital después de 45 años

en.title: Historic day in Madrid: Formula 1 arrives in the capital after 45 years
en.summary: Formula 1 returned to Madrid as host city after 45 years.

stories.title: Sam Altman descarta la salida a Bolsa de OpenAI en 2026: "Dada la situación actual en materia de seguridad, no sería el momento adecuado"

en.title: Sam Altman rules out OpenAI's stock market debut in 2026: "Given the current situation regarding safety, it would not be the right moment"
en.summary: OpenAI's chief executive has stated the company will not pursue an initial public offering in 2026, citing current safety considerations as a limiting factor.

stories.title: Cientos de migrantes de Ceuta, trasladados a una nueva instalación acondicionada

en.title: Hundreds of migrants from Ceuta transferred to a new equipped facility
en.summary: Following violent clashes between migrants near a beach in Ceuta, Spanish National Police arrested at least two people and hospitalized two migrants with knife wounds. Authorities transferred migrants to a newly prepared facility.

stories.title: Trump y donaciones por 84 millones a Farage sacuden la política inglesa

en.title: Trump and donations of 84 million to Farage shake British politics
en.summary: The far-right party Reform UK received two donations of 42 million euros each within two days, while the U.S. president expressed support for Irish reunification, creating political turmoil in Britain.

stories.title: Isabel Rodríguez: Casa 47 habrá puesto 100.000 pisos en alquiler en 10 años

en.title: Isabel Rodríguez: Casa 47 will have placed 100,000 rental apartments in 10 years
en.summary: The Government expects Casa 47, the public housing platform, to offer 100,000 rental apartments over a 10-year period, according to housing minister Isabel Rodríguez.

stories.title: Altman: "Sería poco aconsejable" sacar OpenAI a Bolsa ante los riesgos de la IA

en.title: Altman: "It would be inadvisable" to take OpenAI public given AI risks
en.summary: OpenAI's chief executive ruled out a near-term stock market debut for the ChatGPT creator, stating that 2026 would be an inopportune time due to the need to prioritize resolving safety challenges in advanced artificial intelligence models.

stories.title: No busque la habilidad mejor pagada; pregunte qué problema resuelve y cómo combinarla

en.title: Don't seek the best-paid skill; ask what problem it solves and how to combine it
en.summary: Companies increasingly reward professionals who blend technical expertise with business acumen and leadership to address complex organizational challenges, rather than those skilled in single domains.
